full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Decree of the Military Personnel Management Act) <No. 28266, September 5, 2017>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted>

Articles 2 and 3 Omitted.

Article 4 (Amendment of Other Statutes or Regulations) (1) through (49) Omitted.

(50) Part of the Decree on Divisions shall be amended as follows:

In Article 4 (2), "field-grade officer" shall be replaced with "general officer", and "field-grade officer or" shall be replaced with "general officer or".

(51) through (90) Omitted.
